headline: AI structure models tested against experimental data and mutational constraints
label: Protein Structure Model Validation
summary: Structure and binding predictors are now assessed against experimental ensembles, measured affinities, and deep mutational scans.
synthesis: The dominant thread is testing structure, ensemble, and binding predictors against experimental observables and independent stress tests. Latent-space inference-time optimization with Boltzmann-weighted sampling generates protein ensembles matched to X-ray and NMR data. Benchmarks of AlphaFold3, Protenix, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and DynamicBind on orthosteric versus allosteric ligand complexes link prediction failures to energy-landscape features. Adversarial point and deletion mutations show AlphaFold 3 and ESMFold predictions are largely mutation-invariant, with unreliable confidence. IDRBindNet, trained on the curated IBPC-Kd dataset of 1,785 IDR-protein complexes with measured Kd, targets binding affinity for disordered regions. ESMRank applies learning-to-rank to overlap-aware MAVEdb deep mutational scans to capture mutational constraint. What is new is the use of experimental data and explicit perturbation tests as validation criteria. Pro-GAT, by contrast, repairs fragmented PROTAC linkers from diffusion generation.
